sentences.text: Cambridge Isles 5 by University of Cambridge Esol examinations
sentences.zh: 剑桥大学考试委员会英语考试部《剑桥群岛5》

sentences.text: CD1
sentences.zh: CD1

sentences.text: Test 1
sentences.zh: 测试1

sentences.text: and you'll have to answer questions on what you hear
sentences.zh: 你将需要根据所听到的内容回答问题。

sentences.text: There will be time for you to read the instructions and questions
sentences.zh: 你会有时间阅读说明和题目。

sentences.text: and you'll have a chance to check your work.
sentences.zh: 并且你将有机会检查自己的答案。

sentences.text: At the end of the test, you will be given 10 minutes
sentences.zh: 测试结束时，你将获得10分钟时间。

sentences.text: to transfer your answers to an answer sheet.
sentences.zh: 将答案誊写到答题纸上。

sentences.text: Now turn to section 1.
sentences.zh: 现在请翻到第1部分。

sentences.text: Section 1
sentences.zh: 第1部分

sentences.text: You will hear a telephone conversation
sentences.zh: 你将听到一段电话对话。

sentences.text: between a travel consultant and a customer.
sentences.zh: 对话双方为旅游顾问与顾客。

sentences.text: You will see that there is an example which has been done for you.
sentences.zh: 你会看到有一个已为你做好的示例。

sentences.text: On this occasion only, the conversation relating to this will be played first.
sentences.zh: 本次考试中，仅此一次，与该示例相关的对话将首先播放。

sentences.text: Good afternoon, Dreamtime Travel.
sentences.zh: 下午好，这里是梦幻时光旅行社。

sentences.text: How can I help you?
sentences.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.text: Hello, I'm interested in the holidays you offer along the coast near here.
sentences.zh: 您好，我对你们在附近沿海地区提供的度假产品很感兴趣。

sentences.text: Yes, we operate several tours at the coast.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们在沿海地区运营多条旅游线路。

sentences.text: We're in particular, did you want to go?
sentences.zh: 我们特别想了解，您具体想去哪里？

sentences.text: Yes, we operate several tours at the coast.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们在沿海地区运营多条旅游线路。

sentences.text: We're in particular, did you want to go?
sentences.zh: 我们特别想问一下，您想去吗？

sentences.text: Well, I like the sound of the holiday that mentioned Wales.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我挺喜欢刚才提到的威尔士度假项目的。

sentences.text: Was it Wales watching?
sentences.zh: 是威尔士观鸟吗？

sentences.text: Ah, that's our Wales Watch experience.
sentences.zh: 啊，那是我们的‘威尔士观鸟体验’项目。

sentences.text: It's very popular and it's based in a lovely little town with nice beaches.
sentences.zh: 这个项目非常受欢迎，位于一座风景优美的小镇，那里还有漂亮的海滩。

sentences.text: The holiday is called Wales Watch Experience.
sentences.zh: 该度假项目名为‘威尔士观鸟体验’。

sentences.text: So, Wales Watch Experience has been written on the form.
sentences.zh: 所以，‘威尔士观鸟体验’已填写在表格上了。

sentences.text: Now we shall begin.
sentences.zh: 现在我们开始。

sentences.text: You should answer the questions as you listen because you will not hear the recording a second time.
sentences.zh: 请边听边答题，因为录音只播放一遍。

sentences.text: Listen carefully and answer questions 1-4.
sentences.zh: 请仔细听，并回答第1至第4题。

sentences.text: Good afternoon, Dreamtime Travel. How can I help you?
sentences.zh: 下午好，这里是梦幻时光旅行社。有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.text: Oh, hello, I'm interested in the holidays you offer along the coast near here.
sentences.zh: 哦，您好，我对你们在附近沿海地区提供的度假项目很感兴趣。

sentences.text: Yes, we operate several tours at the coast.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们在沿海地区运营多条旅游线路。

sentences.text: We're in particular, did you want to go?
sentences.zh: 具体来说，您想去哪里呢？

sentences.text: Well, I like the sound of the holiday that mentioned Wales.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我挺喜欢那个提到威尔士的度假项目。

sentences.text: Was it Wales watching?
sentences.zh: 是威尔士观鸟吗？

sentences.text: Ah, that's our Wales Watch Experience.
sentences.zh: 啊，那是我们的‘威尔士观鸟体验’项目。

sentences.text: It's very popular and it's based in a lovely little town with nice beaches.
sentences.zh: 这个项目非常受欢迎，活动基地设在一个风景优美的小镇，那里有漂亮的海滩。

sentences.text: All right. And how long does it last?
sentences.zh: 好的。那这个项目持续多长时间？

sentences.text: It's two days. That includes four hours travel time each way from here.
sentences.zh: 为期两天，其中包括往返各四小时的交通时间。

sentences.text: Good, I don't want to be away any longer than that.
sentences.zh: 很好，我不想离开那么久。

sentences.text: So, is that my coach?
sentences.zh: 所以，那是我的导游吗？

sentences.text: Actually, it's by many best.
sentences.zh: 实际上，它被许多人评为最佳。

sentences.text: We like to keep those two as small and personal, so we don't take a whole coach load of people.
sentences.zh: 我们希望将这两项活动保持得小型且个性化，因此我们不会带一整辆大巴的人去。

sentences.text: In fact, we only take up to 15 people on this tour, although we do run it with just 12 or 13.
sentences.zh: 事实上，本次旅行最多只接待15人，尽管有时仅安排12或13人出行。

sentences.text: All right. So, do you run these tours often?
sentences.zh: 好的。那么，你们经常组织这类旅行吗？

sentences.text: We're at depends on the time of year.
sentences.zh: 这取决于一年中的不同时段。

sentences.text: Of course, in peak times like the summer holidays, we do them every weekend, but at the moment, it's usually once a month at most.
sentences.zh: 当然，在暑期等旅游旺季，我们每周末都组织；但目前，最多每月一次。

sentences.text: And when is the next one going?
sentences.zh: 下一次是什么时候出发？

sentences.text: Hmm, let me see.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我看看。

sentences.text: Ah, there's one in three weeks' time, which is 8, probably 8, and then we don't have another one until June 2nd.
sentences.zh: 啊，三周后就有一趟，大概是8号；之后的下一趟要等到6月2日了。

sentences.text: And is April a good time to go?
sentences.zh: 四月去合适吗？

sentences.text: Pretty good. Though, the really good time is later in the year.
sentences.zh: 相当合适。不过，真正最佳的时间是在一年中稍晚些时候。

sentences.text: I have to say though that the whale sighting is only one of the many things offered.
sentences.zh: 不过我得说明一下，观鲸只是众多活动之一。

sentences.text: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.text: Yes. The hotel itself where your stay has great facilities. It's called the Palisades.
sentences.zh: 是的。您入住的酒店本身设施非常完善，名为‘帕利塞兹’（Palisades）。

sentences.text: The Paris what?
sentences.zh: 巴黎什么？

sentences.text: No. It's actually the Palisades.
sentences.zh: 不，其实是‘帕利塞兹’（Palisades）。

sentences.text: P-A-W-L-I-S-A-D-E-S.
sentences.zh: 拼写为：P-A-L-I-S-A-D-E-S。

sentences.text: It's right on the main beach there.
sentences.zh: 它就坐落在那里的主海滩上。

sentences.text: Oh, I see.
sentences.zh: 哦，我明白了。

sentences.text: All of the rooms have nice views, and the food is really good there too.
sentences.zh: 所有房间都有不错的景观，那里的食物也很好。

sentences.text: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.text: Now listen, and answer questions 5-10.
sentences.zh: 现在请听，并回答第5至10题。

sentences.text: And what about the other things? You know that are included in the price?
sentences.zh: 其他包含在价格内的项目呢？您知道有哪些吗？

sentences.text: Oh, there are lots of things. If you don't want to do the whale watch cruise, your guide will take anyone who is interested either on a bushwalk through the National Park near the hotel,
sentences.zh: 哦，项目很多。如果您不想参加观鲸巡航，您的导游会带任何感兴趣的游客前往酒店附近的国家公园进行丛林徒步旅行，

sentences.text: and there's no extra charge for that, or on a fishing trip.
sentences.zh: 这项活动不另收费；或者去钓鱼。

sentences.text: That's an extra $12 I think.
sentences.zh: 我想那要额外收取12美元。

sentences.text: And there's also a reptile park in town that costs more or less the same.
sentences.zh: 镇上还有一座爬行动物公园，费用大致相同。

sentences.text: No, I think I'd prefer whales to snakes.
sentences.zh: 不，我觉得比起蛇，我更想看鲸鱼。

sentences.text: Here. And if you just want to relax, you're free to sit by the hotel pool or go down the beach.
sentences.zh: 给您。如果您只想放松一下，可以自由地坐在酒店泳池边，或去海滩。

sentences.text: Oh, and they also have tennis courts at the hotel, but you have to pay for those by the hour.
sentences.zh: 哦，酒店还有网球场，但需按小时付费。

sentences.text: But there are table tennis tables downstairs, and they are part of the accommodation package, just speak to your guide.
sentences.zh: 不过楼下有乒乓球桌，这属于住宿套餐的一部分，只需向您的导游咨询即可。

sentences.text: Well, that's nice. Good. So how much is the basic tour price?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很不错。好。那么基础旅游套餐的价格是多少？

sentences.text: At this time of year, it's usually around $300, but let me check.
sentences.zh: 今年这个时节，通常约为300美元，但我来查一下。

sentences.text: Oh, it's actually $280.
sentences.zh: 哦，实际上是280美元。

sentences.text: And the next tour are there any places on that one?
sentences.zh: 下一期旅游团还有空位吗？

sentences.text: How many people is it for?
sentences.zh: 这个团是为多少人安排的？

sentences.text: There are two of us.
sentences.zh: 我们一共两人。

sentences.text: Yes, that should be fine.
sentences.zh: 是的，应该没问题。

sentences.text: Can I just mention that we require all bookings to be made at least 14 days before you travel to avoid cancellations of tours?
sentences.zh: 我可以提一下，为了避免旅游团被取消，我们需要所有预订至少在您出发前14天完成。

sentences.text: And if you cancel within seven days of departure, you will have to pay 50% of your total booking.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果您在出发前七天内取消预订，您需支付全部预订费用的50%。

sentences.text: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.text: And you also need to pay a 20% deposit at the time of booking.
sentences.zh: 此外，您还需在预订时支付20%的定金。

sentences.text: Can I pay that by credit card?
sentences.zh: 我可以用信用卡支付这笔费用吗？

sentences.text: Yes, you can.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.text: All right. What I'll do is I'll talk to my partner and get right to you.
sentences.zh: 好的。我先和我的搭档商量一下，然后马上联系您。

sentences.text: Fine.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.text: So I'll make our provisional booking, shall I?
sentences.zh: 那我先为您做临时预订，可以吗？

sentences.text: Two for the while watch experience. Let me issue you with a customer reference number for when you call back.
sentences.zh: 两人参加观鲸体验。我这就为您生成一个客户参考编号，以便您回电时使用。

sentences.text: Do you have a pin?
sentences.zh: 您有个人识别码（PIN）吗？

sentences.text: Yes.
sentences.zh: 有。

sentences.text: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.text: That's T for tango.
sentences.zh: T代表“tango”（塔戈）。

sentences.text: When you call back, ask to speak to the tour manager. That's me, Tracy.
sentences.zh: 您回电时，请要求与旅游经理通话——也就是我，特蕾西。

sentences.text: Fine. I will.
sentences.zh: 好的，我会的。

sentences.text: That is the end of section one.
sentences.zh: 第一部分到此结束。

sentences.text: You now have half a minute to check your answers.
sentences.zh: 现在您有半分钟时间核对答案。

sentences.text: Now turn to section two.
sentences.zh: 请翻到第二部分。

sentences.text: Section 2
sentences.zh: 第二部分

sentences.text: You will hear a radio program giving parents advice about buying costs for their babies to sleep in.
sentences.zh: 你将听到一档广播节目，为家长们提供关于婴儿睡眠用品购买费用的建议。

sentences.text: Hello and welcome to today's Biobuere program where we give you some tips on how to spend your money widely.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎收听今天的《生物宝典》节目，我们将为您提供一些精打细算的消费小贴士。

sentences.text: Now in today's show we're looking at beds for children and babies.
sentences.zh: 今天节目中，我们将聚焦于儿童及婴儿床。

sentences.text: Let's start by looking at babycotts.
sentences.zh: 我们先从婴儿床开始。

sentences.text: That's for children of up to 3 years old.
sentences.zh: 适用于3岁以下儿童。

sentences.text: We tested 3 different cuts, all in the budget price range and as usual we will feature the good points, the problems and our verdict.
sentences.zh: 我们测试了3款不同品牌的婴儿床，全部属于经济型价位；和往常一样，我们将分别介绍它们的优点、问题以及我们的最终评价。

sentences.text: The first cut we looked at was by baby safe and it had several good points to recommend it.
sentences.zh: 我们首先考察的是‘宝宝安全’牌婴儿床，它具备多项值得推荐的优点。

sentences.text: Our testers liked the fact that it had four wheels, so it was easy to move around.
sentences.zh: 我们的测试人员很喜欢它配备的四个轮子，因此移动起来非常方便。

sentences.text: The only slide problems with this cut were that it had no brakes, but they didn't think that mattered too much.
sentences.zh: 这款婴儿床唯一的缺陷是未安装刹车装置，但测试人员认为这问题并不严重。

sentences.text: At first they were a bit concerned about the sidebar because they felt babies could trap their fingers in it.
sentences.zh: 起初，他们对床的侧栏略感担忧，因为觉得婴儿可能会将手指卡在其中。

sentences.text: But our testers felt that this was unlikely to happen, so they've given this one a verdict of satisfactory.
sentences.zh: 但测试人员随后认为这种情况极不可能发生，因此给予该产品‘满意’的评价。

sentences.text: The next cut was by choice cuts.
sentences.zh: 下一款婴儿床来自‘优选’品牌。

sentences.text: This time our testers were pleased to find a cut which is simple to put together, unlike others we looked at.
sentences.zh: 这一次，测试人员很高兴地发现，这款婴儿床组装起来十分简便，不像我们之前测试的其他产品那样复杂。

sentences.text: On the minor side our testers did not like the fact that the side of the cut did not drop down, making it difficult to pick up newborn babies.
sentences.zh: 不过，测试人员不太满意的一点是：这款婴儿床的侧栏无法放下，导致抱起新生儿时颇为不便。

sentences.text: However the real problem with this cut was the space between the bars.
sentences.zh: 然而，这款婴儿床真正的问题在于栏杆之间的间距。

sentences.text: Our testers found they were too wide and a baby could easily trap his head.
sentences.zh: 测试人员发现栏杆间距过大，婴儿很容易将头部卡住。

sentences.text: We felt this was a real safety hazard, and so we've labelled this one dangerous on the right.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这构成了真正的安全隐患，因此在右侧将其标注为‘危险’。

sentences.text: Now listen and answer questions 18 to 20.
sentences.zh: 请仔细听录音，并回答第18至20题。

sentences.text: And finally better news for the mother's choice cut.
sentences.zh: 最后，让我们带来‘妈妈之选’牌婴儿床的好消息。

sentences.text: This cut was slightly different in that although the sidebar did not drop down, the base could be raised or lowered into two different positions, making it safe as well as convenient.
sentences.zh: 这次的婴儿床设计略有不同，尽管侧栏不会下落，但底座可以升降至两个不同的位置，既安全又方便。

sentences.text: The negatives for this one were quite minor. The only legal everyone had was the fact that it has no wheels and the only other problem anyone could find was that there were pictures, which were simply stuck on and so it could easily become detached.
sentences.zh: 这款婴儿床的缺点相当轻微。所有人一致指出的唯一问题是它没有轮子；其他人发现的另一个问题则是上面的图片只是简单粘贴上去的，因此很容易脱落。

sentences.text: The makers of now promised to discontinue this practice, as this cut will then be safe in every way.
sentences.zh: 该婴儿床制造商现已承诺停止这种做法，这样一来，这款婴儿床将在各方面都确保安全。

sentences.text: We have made the mother's choice cut our best buy. Congratulations mother's choice.
sentences.zh: 我们已将‘妈妈之选’婴儿床评为我们的最佳推荐产品。祝贺‘妈妈之选’！

sentences.text: So what features should you look for in a baby's cut? Well obviously safety is a very important factor as well as comfort and convenience.
sentences.zh: 那么，选购婴儿床时您应关注哪些特性呢？显然，安全性是非常重要的因素，此外还有舒适性和便利性。

sentences.text: We recommend that if you are buying a cut, do make sure that any metal present is not rusted or bent in any way.
sentences.zh: 我们建议：若您购买婴儿床，请务必确认所有金属部件均无锈蚀或弯曲现象。

sentences.text: You should ensure your cut has only rounded or smooth edging without any sharp edges. This is especially important for wooden cuts.
sentences.zh: 您应确保婴儿床仅采用圆角或光滑边缘设计，不得有任何尖锐棱角。这一点对木制婴儿床尤为重要。

sentences.text: And now on to beds for toddlers.
sentences.zh: 接下来介绍幼儿床。

sentences.text: That is the end of section two. You know have half a minute to check your answers.
sentences.zh: 第二部分到此结束。您现在有半分钟时间核对答案。

sentences.text: Now turn to section three.
sentences.zh: 请翻到第三部分。

sentences.text: Section 3
sentences.zh: 第三部分

sentences.text: You will hear a conversation between a student, Andrew, and a student advisor, Monica, about a diploma course.
sentences.zh: 您将听到一名学生安德鲁与学生顾问莫妮卡之间关于管理学文凭课程的一段对话。

sentences.text: Excuse me, I was told to come here for advice about management diploma courses.
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，有人让我来这儿咨询有关管理学文凭课程的事宜。

sentences.text: You have certainly come to the right place.
sentences.zh: 您确实来对地方了。

sentences.text: Hi. My name is Monica.
sentences.zh: 您好，我叫莫妮卡。

sentences.text: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到您。

sentences.text: My name is Andrew. Andrew Harris.
sentences.zh: 我叫安德鲁，安德鲁·哈里斯。

sentences.text: So Andrew, have you seen our diploma course prospectus yet?
sentences.zh: 那么，安德鲁，您看过我们文凭课程的招生简章了吗？

sentences.text: Yes, I've already looked at it. In fact, I thought the information on course content was really useful.
sentences.zh: 是的，我已经看过了。事实上，我觉得其中关于课程内容的信息非常有用。

sentences.text: But I'm afraid I'm a bit confused by all the different ways you can do the course.
sentences.zh: 但我恐怕对课程可选择的多种修读方式仍有些困惑。

sentences.text: Full time intensive part time and so on.
sentences.zh: 全日制、强化型、兼职等等。

sentences.text: Well, let's see if I can help.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我看看能不能帮上忙。

sentences.text: I think each course type has its advantages and disadvantages.
sentences.zh: 我认为每种课程类型都有其优缺点。

sentences.text: So it really depends on you, your own study habits, and your financial circumstances of course.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的取决于你个人的学习习惯，当然还有你的经济状况。

sentences.text: Are you working at the moment?
sentences.zh: 你目前在工作吗？

sentences.text: Yes, I've been working in the administration section of local hospital for the last three years.
sentences.zh: 是的，过去三年我一直在当地一家医院的行政部门工作。

sentences.text: And before that, I worked in the office of a computer engineering company for two years.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，我在一家计算机工程公司的办公室工作了两年。

sentences.text: So I've got about five years of relevant work experience.
sentences.zh: 所以我大约有五年相关的工作经验。

sentences.text: And what I'm hoping to focus on is personnel management.
sentences.zh: 而我希望重点学习的是人事管理。

sentences.text: I see.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.text: And are you planning to leave your current job to study?
sentences.zh: 你打算辞去目前的工作去学习吗？

sentences.text: Or are you thinking about just taking a year off?
sentences.zh: 还是只打算休学一年？

sentences.text: I want to know what my options are, really.
sentences.zh: 我真正想了解的是我的各种选择。

sentences.text: I don't want to quit my job or anything.
sentences.zh: 我并不想辞职什么的。

sentences.text: And my employers are keen for me to get some more qualifications.
sentences.zh: 而且我的雇主也很希望我获得一些更高的资质。

sentences.text: But obviously it would be better if I could do a course without taking too much time away from work.
sentences.zh: 但显然，如果我能参加一个不需要占用太多工作时间的课程，那就更好了。

sentences.text: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.text: So you don't really want to do the full time course then?
sentences.zh: 那么你其实并不想报读全日制课程？

sentences.text: No, not really.
sentences.zh: 不，真的不想。

sentences.text: It's also a question of finances.
sentences.zh: 另外，这也是一个资金问题。

sentences.text: You see, my office have agreed to pay the cost of the course itself.
sentences.zh: 您看，我的办公室已同意支付课程本身的费用。

sentences.text: But I would have to take unpaid leave if I want to study full time.
sentences.zh: 但如果我想全日制学习，我就得休无薪假。

sentences.text: And well, I don't think I could afford to support myself with no salary for a whole year.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得自己无法承受整整一年没有薪水来养活自己。

sentences.text: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.text: Well, you have two other possibilities.
sentences.zh: 嗯，您还有另外两种选择。

sentences.text: You could either do the part-time course that would be over two years and you wouldn't have to take any time off work.
sentences.zh: 您可以选择为期两年的兼职课程，这样您就无需请假离职。

sentences.text: Or you could do what we call a modular course.
sentences.zh: 或者您可以选择我们所谓的模块化课程。

sentences.text: You could do that in 18 months if you wanted or longer.
sentences.zh: 如果您愿意，可以在18个月内完成，也可以花更长时间。

sentences.text: It's quite flexible and it would be up to you.
sentences.zh: 这种课程非常灵活，完全由您自己决定。

sentences.text: So what does the part-time course involve?
sentences.zh: 那么兼职课程具体包括哪些内容呢？

sentences.text: For that you would join an evening class and have a lecture twice a week.
sentences.zh: 对于该课程，您需参加晚间班，每周听两次讲座。

sentences.text: Then you'd have to attend a seminar or discussion workshop one weekend a month.
sentences.zh: 然后您每月还需参加一次周末的研讨会或讨论工作坊。

sentences.text: What kind of course work would I have to do?
sentences.zh: 我需要完成哪些课程作业呢？

sentences.text: Well, it's a mixture.
sentences.zh: 嗯，形式比较多样。

sentences.text: You'd be expected to write an essay each month, which counts towards your final assessment.
sentences.zh: 您需每月撰写一篇论文，计入最终考核成绩。

sentences.text: You have a case study to do by the end of the course, which might involve doing a survey or something like that.
sentences.zh: 课程结束前还需完成一项案例研究，可能涉及开展一项调查之类的工作。

sentences.text: And also you need to hand in a short report every four weeks.
sentences.zh: 此外，您还需每四周提交一份简短报告。

sentences.text: So that's quite a lot of work then on top of working every day.
sentences.zh: 所以这相当于在每天工作之外还要承担大量学习任务。

sentences.text: It sounds like a lot of studying and really tiring.
sentences.zh: 听起来学习量很大，确实会很累。

sentences.text: Yeah, you certainly wouldn't have much free time.
sentences.zh: 是的，您确实几乎不会有多少空闲时间。

sentences.text: What about the modular course?
sentences.zh: 模块化课程怎么样？

sentences.text: Now listen and answer questions 26 to 30.
sentences.zh: 现在请听并回答第26至30题。

sentences.text: What about the modular course?
sentences.zh: 模块化课程怎么样？

sentences.text: What would I have to do for that?
sentences.zh: 我需要为此做些什么呢？

sentences.text: Well that's where you get the opportunity to study full time for short periods.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这正是您有机会进行短期全日制学习的地方。

sentences.text: That way you can cover a lot of course work and attend lectures and seminars during the day.
sentences.zh: 这样，您就能在白天完成大量课程作业，并参加讲座和研讨会。

sentences.text: And each module lasts for one term, say about 12 weeks at a time.
sentences.zh: 而且每个模块持续一个学期，大约每次12周。

sentences.text: There are obvious advantages in this.
sentences.zh: 这种方式显然具有诸多优势。

sentences.text: The main one being that you can study in a much more intensive way, which suits some people much better.
sentences.zh: 最主要的优势在于，您可以以更加密集的方式学习，而这更契合某些人的需求。

sentences.text: And how many of these modules would I have to do to get the diploma?
sentences.zh: 那么，我需要完成多少个这样的模块才能获得文凭呢？

sentences.text: Well the current program is two modules and then you have to choose a topic to work in more depth.
sentences.zh: 目前的课程设置是两个模块，之后您还需选择一个主题进行更深入的研究。

sentences.text: But you can base that on your job and so you don't need to be away from the office.
sentences.zh: 但您可将该研究主题与您的工作相结合，因此无需离开办公室。

sentences.text: And how long it takes is up to you.
sentences.zh: 所需时间长短则由您自行决定。

sentences.text: The important thing is that you don't have to study and work.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，您不必同时兼顾学习与工作。

sentences.text: You can focus on one thing at a time.
sentences.zh: 您可以一次专注于一件事情。

sentences.text: Yes, I can see that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我明白了。

sentences.text: It certainly sounds attractive.
sentences.zh: 这听起来确实很有吸引力。

sentences.text: It would be more expensive though.
sentences.zh: 不过，费用会更高一些。

sentences.text: I mean, I'd have to support myself without pay for each module.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，每个模块期间我都得自费维持生活，且没有薪水。

sentences.text: That's true, so that might be a problem for you.
sentences.zh: 的确如此，所以这可能对您来说是个问题。

sentences.text: Look, why don't you talk this over with your employers and then come on.
sentences.zh: 看，你为什么不先和你的雇主商量一下，然后再来呢。

sentences.text: That is the end of section three.
sentences.zh: 这是第三部分的结束。

sentences.text: You now have half a minute to check your answers.
sentences.zh: 现在你有半分钟的时间检查你的答案。

sentences.text: Now turn to section four.
sentences.zh: 现在请翻到第四部分。

sentences.text: Section 4
sentences.zh: 第四部分

sentences.text: You will hear part of a lecture given by an economist about North American women's attitude to money and saving.
sentences.zh: 你将听到一位经济学家所作讲座的一部分，内容是关于北美女性对金钱和储蓄的态度。

sentences.text: Okay, so we've been looking at the attitudes of various social and cultural groups towards the management of their personal finances.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们一直在探讨各种社会和文化群体对个人财务管理的态度。

sentences.text: How important they feel it is to save money and what they save their money for.
sentences.zh: 他们认为储蓄有多重要，以及他们储蓄的目的。

sentences.text: One aspect that we haven't yet considered is gender.
sentences.zh: 我们尚未考虑的一个方面是性别。

sentences.text: So if we consider gender issues, we're basically asking whether men and women have different attitudes towards saving money and whether they save money for different things.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们考虑性别问题，基本上就是在问：男性和女性对储蓄是否持有不同的态度，以及他们储蓄的目的是否不同。

sentences.text: Back in 1928, the British writer George Bernard Shaw wrote in his Intelligent Women's Guide to Socialism and Capitalism.
sentences.zh: 早在1928年，英国作家乔治·伯纳德·肖在其《聪明女性的社会主义与资本主义指南》中写道：

sentences.text: That a man is supposed to understand politics, economics and finance and is therefore unwilling to accept essential instruction.
sentences.zh: 男性理应懂得政治、经济和金融，因此不愿接受基本的指导。

sentences.text: He also said, a woman having fewer pretensions is far more willing to learn.
sentences.zh: 他还说，女性自视较低，因而更乐于学习。

sentences.text: Now, though these days people might question a lot of the assumptions contained in those statements,
sentences.zh: 如今，人们或许会对这些说法中包含的许多假设提出质疑，

sentences.text: recent research does suggest that there are some quite fundamental differences between men and women in their attitudes to economic matters.
sentences.zh: 但近期的研究确实表明，男性和女性在对待经济事务的态度上存在一些相当根本的差异。

sentences.text: Let's look at what men and women actually save for.
sentences.zh: 让我们来看看男性和女性实际储蓄的目的。

sentences.text: Research studies of women in North America have found that women are far more likely to save for their children's education,
sentences.zh: 针对北美女性开展的研究发现，女性更倾向于为子女教育而储蓄，

sentences.text: and they are also more likely to save up in order to buy a house one day.
sentences.zh: 她们也更可能储蓄以期将来购置房产。

sentences.text: The same studies have found that men, on the other hand, tend to save for a car, which, by the way, takes a surprisingly large amount of the household budget in North America.
sentences.zh: 同样的研究还发现，相比之下，男性则倾向于为购买汽车而储蓄——顺便提一句，在北美，购车开支在家庭预算中所占比例出人意料地高。

sentences.text: But the other main priority for men when saving money is their retirement.
sentences.zh: 但男性储蓄的另一主要目标则是退休。

sentences.text: When they're earning, they're far more likely to put money aside for their old age than women are.
sentences.zh: 当她们有收入时，她们为老年储蓄的可能性远高于男性。

sentences.text: Now, this is rather disturbing because, in fact, the need for women to save for their old age is far greater than for men.
sentences.zh: 现在，这相当令人担忧，因为事实上，女性为老年储蓄的需求远大于男性。

sentences.text: Let's consider this for a moment.
sentences.zh: 让我们花点时间来考虑一下这个问题。

sentences.text: To start with, it is a fact that throughout the world, women are likely to live many years longer than men, so they need money to support them during this time.
sentences.zh: 首先，事实是，全世界范围内的女性预期寿命都比男性长很多年，因此她们需要资金来支撑这段时期的生活。

sentences.text: Since women are likely to be the ones left without a partner in old age, they may therefore have to pay for nursing care, because they don't have a spouse to look after them.
sentences.zh: 由于女性在老年时更可能失去伴侣，因此她们可能不得不自费支付护理服务，因为身边没有配偶来照顾她们。

sentences.text: Furthermore, the high divorce rates in North America are creating a poverty cycle for women.
sentences.zh: 此外，北美地区居高不下的离婚率正在使女性陷入贫困循环。

sentences.text: It is the divorced women who will most often have to look after the children, and thus, they need more money to look after, not just themselves, but others.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，离婚后的女性往往需要独自抚养孩子，因此她们不仅需要为自己，还需要为他人筹措更多资金。

sentences.text: So what can be done about this situation?
sentences.zh: 那么，针对这一状况，我们能做些什么呢？

sentences.text: The population in North America is likely to contain an increasing number of elderly women.
sentences.zh: 北美人口中老年女性的数量很可能持续增加。

sentences.text: The research indicates that, at present, for women, it takes a crisis to make them think about their future financial situation.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，目前对女性而言，往往要等到危机发生时，才会开始思考自己未来的财务状况。

sentences.text: But of course, this is the very worst time for anyone to make important decisions.
sentences.zh: 但显然，这恰恰是任何人做出重要决策的最糟糕时机。

sentences.text: Women today need to look ahead, think ahead, not wait until their under pressure.
sentences.zh: 当今女性需要未雨绸缪、提前规划，而不是等到压力临头才行动。

sentences.text: Even women in their early 20s need to think about pensions, for example, and with increasing numbers of women in professional positions,
sentences.zh: 例如，即便二十出头的女性也需要开始考虑养老金问题；而且随着越来越多女性进入专业岗位，

sentences.text: there are signs that this is beginning to happen.
sentences.zh: 已有迹象表明，这种情况正逐渐发生。

sentences.text: Then research also suggests that women avoid dealing effectively with their economic situation because of a lack of confidence.
sentences.zh: 研究还指出，女性因缺乏自信而回避有效处理自身经济状况。

sentences.text: The best way for them to overcome this is by getting themselves properly informed, so they are less dependent on other people's advice.
sentences.zh: 克服这一点的最佳方式是主动获取充分信息，从而减少对他人的建议依赖。

sentences.text: A number of initiatives have been set up to help them do this.
sentences.zh: 目前已设立多项举措来帮助她们实现这一点。

sentences.text: This college, for example, is one of the educational institutions which offers night classes in money management, and increasing numbers of women are enrolling on such courses.
sentences.zh: 例如，本学院就是提供晚间理财管理课程的教育机构之一，且报名此类课程的女性人数正不断增加。

sentences.text: Here, they can be given advice on different ways of saving.
sentences.zh: 在这里，她们可获得关于不同储蓄方式的专业建议。

sentences.text: Many women are unwilling to invest in stocks and shares, for instance, but these can be extremely profitable.
sentences.zh: 例如，许多女性不愿投资股票和股份，但这类投资实际上可能带来极高收益。

sentences.text: It is usually advised that at least 70% of a person's savings should be in low risk investments, but for the rest financial advisors often advise taking some well-informed risks.
sentences.zh: 通常建议，一个人的储蓄中至少70%应投入低风险投资，但对剩余部分，财务顾问往往建议采取一些经过充分了解的风险投资。

sentences.text: Initiatives such as this can give women the economic skills and knowledge they need for a comfortable, independent retirement.
sentences.zh: 此类举措可为女性提供实现舒适、独立退休生活所需的经济技能和知识。

sentences.text: The increasing proportion of elderly women in the population is likely to have other economic consequences.
sentences.zh: 人口中老年女性比例不断上升，可能会带来其他经济影响。

sentences.text: That is the end of Section 4.
sentences.zh: 第四部分到此结束。

sentences.text: You now have half a minute to check your answers.
sentences.zh: 现在有半分钟时间检查您的答案。

sentences.text: That is the end of the listening test.
sentences.zh: 听力测试到此结束。

sentences.text: In the Isle test, you would now have 10 minutes to transfer your answers to the listening answer sheet.
sentences.zh: 在雅思考试中，您现在将有10分钟时间把答案誊写到听力答题纸上。

sentences.text: The end of Section 4.
sentences.zh: 第四部分结束。
